title: vitex ferruginea var. amboniensis
intro: Vitex ferruginea var. amboniensis, commonly known as Ambon ironwort, is a plant species native to Indonesia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional Indonesian medicine. The health benefits of Ambon ironwort include its potential to treat menstrual disorders, reduce stress, and alleviate symptoms of menopause. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include iridoid glycosides and phenolic compounds, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
